ns2:course.label: Research Methods I
ns2:course.description: Optional Capstone experience for International/Global Studies students. Students will develop research, communication and presentation skills; develop a proposal for an independent research project, goals and timeline. The proposal will include a literature review and methods section for their final project. Topics include: research approaches, design and implementation, as well as methods, analysis and ethics of data collection. No graduate credit. Prerequisite: GLBL 200.
